title: David Ruiz: a three-fingered humanoid species, not extraterrestrial

tellings.quote: Never in the eight years I've been researching have I mentioned or said the word extraterrestrial. Never. We are talking about humanoid species. We are talking about perhaps a hominid like us, a three-fingered hominid.

plain: The three-fingered bodies found in Peru are not extraterrestrial but a humanoid species, perhaps "a three-fingered hominid" like us, according to David Ruiz, who has studied them. Ruiz tells Michels that in eight years of research he has never once used the word extraterrestrial. If he is right, it would mean an unknown relative of humans once existed.
